performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; 3-day signal flat near zero—creative drought, not demand.

findings.text: ROAS fell 63% WoW to 3.58; last 3 days (Aug 18–20) show 2 purchases and $228.98 revenue vs 3 purchases and $421.86 in prior 3 (Aug 15–17). Efficiency deteriorating, not stabilising.
Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event recorded. Missing real-footage creative leaves fatigued ad assets unchallenged.
GBP actions crashed to 0 on Aug 19–20 (vs daily average of ~18 over prior 28 days), a 3-day collapse. Local demand signal is dark, compounding paid weakness.

57% of 28-day spend ($854.84 of $1,503.97) is concentrated in one campaign. With purchases averaging under 1/day in the last 3 days, this single-campaign bet has insufficient conversion volume to self-optimise.
IG reach fell to 593–615 over Aug 18–20, the lowest sustained 3-day window in the 45-day series (peak was 1,214 on Jul 27). Organic amplification is near zero.

suggestions.text: Escalate Shoot 1 delivery immediately; block new creative into top campaign within 7 days to break fatigue cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Shoot 1 milestone (due Aug 14) is overdue with no completed event recorded. The top campaign holds $854.84 of $1,503.97 spend and generated only 2 purchases across Aug 18–20, which is insufficient volume for Meta to self-optimise. Nacer to confirm delivery status and assign new cut deadline by Aug 25. Success check: at least one new real-footage creative live in the top campaign by Aug 28.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions daily; if Aug 21–23 remain at zero, escalate as a possible profile issue before attributing to demand.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on both Aug 19 and Aug 20 after averaging ~18/day for the prior month. This is a 3-day data gap that could indicate a profile suspension, listing issue, or genuine local demand drop. Check GBP profile status today (Aug 21) and log daily action counts through Aug 23. If still at zero by Aug 24, treat as a confirmed profile issue and escalate to fix before crediting any paid recovery.

suggestions.text: Hold budget flat at ~$50/day; do not scale top campaign until new creative is live and 3-day ROAS recovers above 5.0.
suggestions.monday_update: ROAS is confirmed at 3.58 (28d) and deteriorating, with only 2 purchases and $228.98 revenue in the last 3 days. Scaling into a fatigued campaign at this efficiency would compound losses. Hold daily spend at approximately $50/day (current ~$53/day) and re-check after new creative (S1) has run for 3 full days. Success signal: 3-day ROAS back above 5.0 and purchases ≥ 2/day before any budget increase is approved.
